findings.question: Open edge 3 of research/work-items/RE-005-node115-tls-value-object, answered against the same artifact: park_timeout 0x5cfd9a0 (three calls, one tail jump, recorded there) left the timeout values untraced; this packet fixes the provenance of the duration argument at every reference, and the complete supply above it.
findings.representation: SETTLED. Every layer passes the timeout as a (secs u64, nanos u32) register pair; at park_timeout the pair arrives as (rsi, rdx) and is saved at 0x5cfd9be (rsi -> r15) and 0x5cfd9bc (edx -> ebp), with a zero pair returning right after the entry consume CAS. The nanos word is the infinity sentinel: nanos == 0x3b9aca00 (1_000_000_000) means no timeout, and every consumer tests the nanos word alone -- dispatch cmp at 0x5cf6a9a, wrapper_state cmp at 0x5ce3019, registration_a cmp at 0x5cfb7ee, registration_b cmp at 0x5cec938, forwarder cmp at 0x5cfde70, forwarder entry check on the base pair nanos at 0x5cfdd0e ([ctx+0x90]). The secs word is a don't-care whenever nanos is the sentinel.
findings.site_tail_jump: SETTLED, pass-through. 0x5ce0193 is the tail jump in selector_timeout 0x5ce0160 (panic Location io/driver.rs line 165 col 32): taken when the pair word at [pair+0] is 1 and [pair+8] is 0, it moves its own (rdx, rcx) to (rsi, rdx) at 0x5ce0187/0x5ce018a and tail-jumps with rdi = [pair+0x10] + 0x10. Nothing is computed; the value is whatever the selector was given.
findings.site_forwarder_passthrough: SETTLED, pass-through. Call 0x5cfdfa5 in forwarder 0x5cfdd00 is the arm where the flag returned by wheel_resolve 0x5cf6390 for the context's wheel state at +0x58 is clear: it forwards the entry pair unchanged (secs saved to [rsp] at 0x5cfdd49, nanos saved to ebp at 0x5cfdd1e) to the payload at [pair+8] + 0x10.
findings.site_forwarder_capped: SETTLED, computed and capped -- the only genuinely computed timeout in the graph. With the resolver flag set, the forwarder takes the millisecond budget from wheel_resolve (the wheel state read at ctx+0x58, lea pin 0x5cfdd4d), computes elapsed = clock now (clock body 0x5c842e0) minus the base timestamp stored as a (secs, nanos) pair at ctx+0x88/+0x90 (reads pinned at 0x5cfddac/0x5cfddb3) via instant_sub 0x5c84210, converts to milliseconds with saturation, and forms remaining = budget - elapsed (saturating). The call at 0x5cfdeab passes min(remaining, caller pair) compared lexicographically on (secs, nanos), except a caller nanos equal to the sentinel (cmp pin 0x5cfde70) skips the min and passes the full remaining. A zero remaining instead takes the consume-notification arm at 0x5cfdeb5. The adjusted budget is also stored back to ctx+0x78.
findings.site_loop_body: SETTLED, computed but unreached. Call 0x5cf29c8 in loop_body 0x5cf27c0 passes the remaining time to the body's own deadline: the entry pair (rdx, rcx; saved at 0x5cf27d4/0x5cf27d1) becomes an absolute deadline at entry (clock call 0x5cf283f, checked add 0x5cf2847 with an overflow panic), and each pending poll recomputes deadline - now through instant_sub (call 0x5cf298a), saturating at zero. The chain above it can only supply the sentinel: loop_body is called only by dispatch 0x5cf6a90 (call pin 0x5cf6b60; dispatch diverts on the sentinel cmp 0x5cf6a9a and returns on a zero pair), dispatch only by park_wrap 0x5cf3fe0 (a register pass-through of its own (rsi, rdx), pins 0x5cf3ff1/0x5cf3ff3/0x5cf414e), and park_wrap's only three callers each load edx = 0x3b9aca00 immediately before the call (pins 0x15deec8, 0x2abbaf8, 0x5cf8648). The finite arm of this chain therefore never executes in this artifact.
findings.supply_census: SETTLED. Above the selectors: selector_timeout/selector_park are called only by wrapper_state 0x5ce2fd0 (0x5ce3022, 0x5ce3045, zero-duration arm 0x5ce2ff3) and registration_a 0x5cfb780 (0x5cfb7f6, 0x5cfb801); wrapper_state is called only by registration_b 0x5cec8b0 (0x5cec9d9). Both registration bodies hardwire secs = 0 (registration_a xor pin 0x5cfb7fd; registration_b xor pin 0x5cec9d4 with the nanos forwarded at 0x5cec9d6) and forward a bare nanos word. All six registration call sites supply nanos in {0, 0x3b9aca00} only: xor-zeroed at 0x5cece57 and 0x5ced565 (into registration_b, from top_reg_b 0x5cecc60) and at 0x5cfb67d and 0x5cfba81 (into registration_a, from top_reg_a1/top_reg_a2), the sentinel constant at 0x5ced788 and 0x5cfbbed. A sentinel nanos is diverted to selector_park on both paths, so the pair that actually reaches selector_timeout from this graph is (0, 0). The rela addend census over all nineteen bodies finds exactly two pointer references -- slots 0x64e1790/0x64e1798 of a larger function-pointer table hold top_reg_a1 0x5cfb610 and top_reg_a2 0x5cfb920 -- and both of those bodies hardwire the supplies above in their own code regardless of how they are invoked; no body that receives a duration has any pointer reference, so no indirect route injects a different value.
findings.forwarder_identity: The selectors' panic arms reference io/driver.rs -- selector_timeout line 165 col 32, selector_park line 160 col 32, both with the io_disabled message -- and the forwarder's reference time/mod.rs: line 214 col 32 carries the timers_disabled message and fires at entry when the nanos word of the base pair at [ctx+0x90] equals the sentinel; line 217 col 9 carries "assertion failed: !handle.is_shutdown()" and fires when the byte at [ctx+0x80] is set. The two files' path strings are recovered from .rela.dyn RELATIVE addends (0x44281e and 0x43e4fe), not from bytes at the Location statics.

open_edges: What selects the direct arm: the pair word at [pair+0] takes values beyond 0 and 1 in this graph (the selectors test only == 0 / == 1 and fall to a slow path through 0x5ceed20, 0x5ce7380 and 0x5cee650 otherwise). Who writes the pair word and the payloads at [pair+8]/[pair+0x10] is not traced here; that is open edge 2 of the TLS value-object packet and stays open.

The writers of the time context fields the forwarder reads -- the wheel state at ctx+0x58, the base pair at ctx+0x88/+0x90, the shutdown byte at ctx+0x80, and the adjusted budget stored to ctx+0x78 -- and the forwarder exit path's call through 0x5ceaa20, which recomputes the remaining period itself, are not traced. The cap rule is pinned; the state lifecycle is not.

The contention fallback registration_b calls when its byte claim at [entry+8] fails (body 0x5ce30d0, listed as beyond-boundary in the TLS value-object packet) is not traced here; by the censuses above it cannot reach park_timeout except through the same chains.

Open edges 1 (the parking-layer consume bit/counter protocol), 2 (the pair onward fields) and 4 (the park_timeout owner type name) of the TLS value-object packet are untouched by this packet and remain open.

Whether the loop-body chain's finite arm is dead in every build or only unreached from the three sentinel wrappers found here is a census statement about this artifact only; a future artifact could revive it without changing any body pinned here.
